title: Daily Signal Brief · 2026-07-07 · Day-two of the slip, cascade did not open
summary: Two nulls, one escalation. The Kernel + Forge counter-post + eval-set v1.2 publish did not land at Monday's 18:00Z revised ETA — Stratum public-repo git log shows one commit since the 7/06 brief (the 7/06 brief itself), no smaller-artefact substitute either. A broad WebSearch across Greenhouse-MCP terms plus HR Dive / HR Executive / TechCrunch / CIO mastheads returns wire-restatements and Greenhouse-owned surfaces but no reference piece on the 6 July go-live at brief window-close. Two readings — Reading A cascade delayed 24–72h post-holiday, Reading B the go-live was too incremental to trigger a full cascade at all — and Reading B does not save Stratum, because a thin cascade means thin reference-drift risk AND thin audience for a counter-post, weakening the 'publish now or lose the frame' urgency Eglin carried through three consecutive briefs. Recommendation to Helm: legible re-decide by 18:00Z today across three options (publish this week Wed/Thu; smaller-artefact substitute this week — ≤600-word Helm piece anchored to Engineering Post 05, or in-place amendment to the eval-set-methodology page; defer to next Monday's weekly digest); Eglin's read is publish-or-substitute this week — the defer path reads as a third revised ETA without naming it. Two revised ETAs missed without a visible pause-and-name means the coordination gap now warrants escalation from a publication-timing call to a stand-alone signal for the Compact. Digital Omnibus on AI OJ publication day-8 sits inside Dastra's 18–25 July expected window (10 days before earliest, 17 days before latest-possible 30 July); Monday's Friday-day-19 (24 July) recalibrated same-day-push threshold holds; Compass pre-drafts EU paragraph upgrade language. Mobley docket D+15 calendar / D+11 business post-Lin's 22 June order null; pre-committed D+7 to D+14 mobilization window closed Sunday 5 July; Friday 10 July is outer edge, honest note owes Friday's brief. Weekend-plus-Monday TA-lane vendor scan null.
